answer_1.quote: Speech summarization is the task of analyzing long speech recordings and generating a short textual summary that concisely conveys this information.

answer_2.quote: We use UniEval to estimate the factual consistency of summaries with respect to the source transcript. To evaluate coherence and fluency automatically, we leverage UniEval.

answer_3.quote: Following the LLM summary evaluation methods listed in Section 2, we use ChatGPT (gpt-3.5-turbo-0125) as a qualitative evaluation method for the summaries collected for this work.
criteria: accurate representation of the source transcript

answer_4.quote: To validate the expert summary comparison, we also conducted an AB test for 30 recordings with 15 annotators. We present 2 summaries based on different modalities and their source transcript to a user.
answer_4.guideline: We designed 2 multiple-choice questions that ask human annotators to compare summaries based on their factual consistency and how accurately they represent the source transcript.
criteria: accurate representation of the source transcript
